Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path __between tissue layers__; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path; and introducing a medical element into the working channel to perform a medical procedure on the brain.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is an instrument __or a medicament__.

Claim 4 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising creating an opening in a cranium, and inserting the elongated device through the opening __to access the brain tissue__.

Claim 5 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising __inserting the elongated device in proximity to the target site within the brain__. 

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; __and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue__.

Claim 10 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 7, further comprising __placing the elongated device between tissue layers within the tissue__.

Claim 13 (Currently Amended): A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device, having a first radially expandable body, surrounded by a stent, which is surrounded by a second radially expandable body, into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the second expandable body against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially expanding the first expandable body to radially expand the stent to reinforce the second expandable body against the tissue; radially contracting and removing the first expandable body to create a working channel through the stent; introducing a medical element through the channel to perform a medical procedure on the tissue; and radially contracting the second expandable body and removing the device from the tissue __after performing the medical procedure__.

Claim 14 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is an instrument __or a medicament__.

Claim 16 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 13, further comprising inserting the elongated device __in proximity to the target site__ between tissue layers.
